selection: best validation PSNR (valid split of PanCollection)
prepare: python scripts/make_bases.py --dataset wv3 --split train,valid,reduced,full && python scripts/make_bases.py --dataset wv2 --split reduced,full
train: python train_pancoll.py --model PAN-Crafter-in --dataset wv3 --device cuda:0 --max_hours 48 --eval_every 2000 --skip S_PAN --tag _skipS_PAN --results_dir results_panbase
train_note: training runs in segments of at most 48 h; continue an interrupted run with the same command plus --resume. The recipe is the method's published one, identical for the three arms.
infer: python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm s_pan --train-set wv3 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/s_pan/wv3_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm s_pan --train-set wv3 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/s_pan/wv3_full
python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm s_pan --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split reduced --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/s_pan/wv2_reduced
python scripts/infer.py --method PAN-Crafter --arm s_pan --train-set wv3 --eval-set wv2 --split full --weights weights/PanBase --out-dir outputs/PAN-Crafter/s_pan/wv2_full
runtime_note: needs ctx['lpan'], the MS-resolution low-pass PAN distributed with the upstream repository; WorldView-2 has none, the table synthesises it (lpan_synth.lpan_from_pan).
inference_seed: torch.manual_seed(0) immediately before each test image
